purpose: Adapt the mature CN AlphaFactory engine flow into crypto without modifying CN and without inheriting CN search memory payloads.

inheritance_layers.description: Read CN source and runtime manifests read-only; produce component inventory and gap matrix.
Port FormulaGenV2, typed AST, macros, paired ablation, and motif packs into a crypto namespace with crypto field mapping.
Port search memory schema, fingerprinting, diversity keys, and ledger policy with a fresh crypto memory namespace.
Port replay-aware ranker and selector stack using only pre-replay crypto-safe features.
Port large-search supervisor/worker and successive-halving orchestration after parity smoke.
Port proof suite, locked forward, shadow, and regime/book components only after research candidate pool exists.

hard_forbidden: Do not import CN search_memory.json or candidate_ledger.json into crypto.
Do not import CN expression_keys, skeleton_keys, duplicate_skip_events, records, or replay_enrichment_paths.
Do not use CN stock fields without crypto field adapter mapping.
Do not run CN reward weights directly on crypto panels.
Do not use post-replay or May/future stress labels as pre-replay ranker features.
Do not modify the CN repository.
